name: Dragnet
summary: Rural southern NSW/NE Vic ISP (DragNet Internet Services Pty Ltd, ACN 073 567 781; first POP Junee 1996, base later Albury/Wodonga); dialup then ADSL/satellite/wireless; acquired by Enterprise IT Global 2011 (which went into administration Sep 2011); customer base sold to EFTel ~2013.

events.details: Operating since April 1996 (first POP Junee NSW).
Acquired by Eftel — customer base sold to Eftel; Eftel notice Jan 2014; deregistered 2015.

refs.label: DragNet's parent Enterprise IT Global went into voluntary administration in Sep 2011.
Local press confirms the administration of the DragNet operator.
Jan 2014 Eftel notice confirms the acquisition of the customer base c. 2013.
Whirlpool discussion of the 2011 Enterprise IT Global merger.
